accounting: fixed declared arithmetic cost per training update; excludes augmentation/preprocessing, validation, checkpoint I/O and precision-management overhead
budget_selection: Budget selection uses baseline final scores only; all pilot costs are reported separately.
Selected pilot is reused as the comparison baseline; count it once when totaling actual compute.
Fold 0, seed 0 is exploratory. Freeze before additional folds/seeds; use untouched test data for confirmatory claims.
Every objective starts from the same seeded initialization, not the selected baseline checkpoint.
learning_rate_policy: 5% linear warmup, cosine decay to 1% initial LR over allotted updates
